answer: A farm running 27 keys thus pays that exposure 27 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The sonnet escrow holds each stake, the prism settlement releases it, and the falcon audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 20% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
